name: Illran
source:
Strengths : Good brawler, shrewd, crafty, cultivated
Weaknesses : poor alcohol tolerance, lost in cities

Growing up, tricking and stealing were his favorite hobbies. At the age of 15, Illran took up bounty hunting and information brokering, two professions that unsurprisingly go hand in hand.

You'll usually find Illran on the road, traveling from place to place with his companion Veras.

His friendly attitude will make you warm up instantly to him, for better or for worse. You would accidentally tell him anything.

[From the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gabmag/the-divine-speaker-a-fantasy-bl-yaoi-gay-visual-no]Kickstarter campaign[/url]]

He knows how to flirt to his advantage, and does it a lot. He always knows what he’s doing, and makes sure to be in the right place at the right time. He’s very close with Veras, and would put his life on the line for him. The way he talks to Veras is gentler than with other people.
